comparison.objective: Diagnose a blink code and replace a keyed module versus commission an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Temporal code reading, module extraction/insertion, and button holding versus recessed-key work, collar rotation, locking, and repeated impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct spare seated and verified green with healthy modules untouched versus two non-bottoming stops and a lock witness test.
comparison.reason: Both include a physical control and verification, but only the candidate tests mechanical damping adjustment from dynamic response. Candidate verification thresholds remain partly unspecified.
